ELA / K-2

Read-Aloud Question Stems for Big Feelings

A one-page set of oral comprehension prompts for primary read-alouds about characters, feelings, and choices.

NYS framework label
NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards
Alignment note
Supports listening, speaking, key details, and character response work in early literacy lessons.
Classroom use case
Keep beside a read-aloud basket and choose two prompts for turn-and-talk or rug discussion.
SDI support idea
Includes a classroom planning support that helps teachers adjust access, directions, response mode, or grouping without creating legal IEP documentation.
MLL/ELL support idea
Includes language-access guidance such as vocabulary preview, sentence frames, visuals, oral rehearsal, or partner talk for multilingual learners.

Preview

  • What happened first, next, and last?
  • How did the character feel? What clue helped you know?
  • What would you tell the character if you could help?
